docs.title: User Guide
docs.intro: Welcome to 🍌🐱 Banana Cat Launchpad! This guide covers everything you need to know.
docs.needHelpDesc: Can't find what you need? Reach out to the community for assistance.
docs.needHelp2: or report issues on our GitHub.
docs.step1Body: Click the 'Connect Wallet' button at the top right. We support all major EVM wallets including MetaMask, Coinbase Wallet, Rainbow, and Rabby. Make sure you are on a Testnet to avoid losing real assets.
docs.step2Body: Get free test tokens from a faucet. Visit our /tokens page to find faucet links for the chain you want. Each chain has its own native gas token.
docs.step3Body: Click 'Create Token' to launch your own meme coin, or browse /leaderboard to find hot tokens to buy. Both are 1-2 clicks.
docs.createDesc: Launch a meme coin in 4 simple steps
docs.fieldLogoDesc: Upload image or paste IPFS URL. We auto-compress and pin to IPFS.
docs.fieldDescriptionDesc: Tell the world what your token is about
docs.chooseCategoryDesc: Pick from 10 categories (Meme, AI, DeFi, etc.). Each category has dedicated badges on the leaderboard.
docs.fieldLockPeriodDesc: How long your LP stays locked before you can withdraw it. Permanent = LP is burned forever (most trustworthy).
docs.fieldBuyTaxDesc: Percentage fee on each buy (0-10%). Used for liquidity, marketing, or anti-bot.
docs.fieldSellTaxDesc: Same but for sells. Many projects use higher sell tax to discourage dumps.
docs.fieldAntiSniperDesc: First ~10 blocks charge extra tax to discourage snipers. Tax linearly decreases to 0.
docs.reviewLaunchDesc: Check everything before paying the launch fee (~0.005 BNB equivalent).
docs.tradeDesc: Buy and sell tokens through the bonding curve or DEX
docs.howToBuySteps:
1. Go to a token detail page
2. Enter the amount of platform currency (BNB/ETH) you want to spend
3. Click 'Buy'
4. Confirm in wallet
docs.howToSellSteps:
1. Same as buy, but click 'Sell'
2. Enter the number of tokens to sell
3. Slippage tolerance: 1-5%
docs.graduationDesc: When a token's bonding curve fills up, it automatically migrates to a DEX (Uniswap/PancakeSwap). All seeded LP is added to the DEX, and you can trade freely.
docs.slippageDesc: Default is 1%. For volatile tokens, set 3-5% to avoid failed transactions.
docs.lpDesc: We let you choose how long LP is locked — and we have an option to burn it permanently.
docs.permanentLockDesc: LP tokens are sent to a burn address. No one, not even you, can ever withdraw them. The strongest trust signal.
docs.timeLockDesc: LP is locked in our LPLocker contract for a chosen period (7/30/90/365 days). After unlock, you may withdraw or extend.
docs.whyMattersDesc: Without LP lock, creators can withdraw liquidity at any time ('rug pull'). With our system, your LP is verifiably committed — either temporarily or forever.
docs.leaderboardDesc: Find the hottest tokens in 7 different ways
docs.lbHotDesc: Overall popularity based on trading activity
docs.lbTrendDesc: Fastest growing in trade frequency (last 7 days)
docs.commentDesc: Talk to other traders without leaving the page
docs.rule1Desc: No FUD, no shilling scams. Constructive criticism welcome.
docs.rule2Desc: Don't post the same message repeatedly or with irrelevant links.
docs.rule3Desc: We support 14 languages — please write in the language people can read.
docs.reportCommentDesc: Click the flag icon on any comment to report it. We review all reports and act within 24h.
docs.languageDesc: We support 14 languages. Switch via the language picker at the top right.
docs.themeDesc: Dark or light mode. Click the moon/sun icon at the top right.
docs.walletDesc: Connect/disconnect, view your wallet address and balance.
docs.networkDesc: Switch between BSC / Ethereum / Robinhood / Arc testnets using the chain selector.
docs.faq1A: An AMM that automatically sets the price based on supply and demand. When people buy, the price goes up; when they sell, the price goes down. No order book needed.
docs.faq2Q: How much does it cost to launch?
docs.faq2A: About 0.005 BNB (or equivalent on other chains) plus gas. The platform fee covers contract deployment and IPFS upload.
docs.faq3Q: What's the difference between lock periods?
docs.faq3A: Locked = LP is in a smart contract you cannot withdraw until time expires. Burned = LP tokens are sent to a dead address — nobody can ever take them back.
docs.faq4A: Common causes: (1) Insufficient gas — try a higher slippage or check your wallet balance. (2) Wrong network — make sure you're on the right testnet. (3) Front-run bot — try again with higher gas.
docs.faq5Q: Can I edit my token later?
docs.faq5A: Symbol, name, description can be updated by the creator once via updateMetadata(). LP lock period cannot be changed after launch (trust safety).
docs.faq6A: All contracts are verified and on testnet. Mainnet will require a full audit before launch. We do not custody your funds — everything is on-chain.
docs.supportDesc: Get help, report bugs, suggest features
